policy: Only 38 explicitly source/caller-reviewed Medium contexts: 34 operator paths, one quoted H2 metadata identifier and three fixed/admitted local process boundaries. Exact canonical annotations/locations must match; observed raw hashes remain as provenance. Every production Java or Maven change requires re-review.

reviewed_findings.context: Configured snapshot root and derived staging name
reviewed_findings.rationale: The staging parent is a private final constructor @Value exports root with the fixed ai-snapshots child. Local farm-data export requests supply a printable bounded export key, hashed into farm-export-[0-9a-f]{32}; they cannot set a parent or arbitrary filename. Snapshot IDs/chunk leaves are separately validated. This does not claim resistance to a malicious local owner replacing the trusted export root.

The package-private RecordsReadProbe.readAll helper accepts only an existing JDBC connection from DatabaseIntegrityGuard.check or RestoreService.probeRecords. Table names come exclusively from H2 INFORMATION_SCHEMA PUBLIC BASE TABLE metadata, are quoted as one identifier and have every embedded quote doubled. It reads each row and column with no HTTP/request SQL identifier. Configured credentials and scratch-record connections remain owned by integrity/verified-backup checks; failed copies receive unique derived local filenames. The quoted-table/non-admin regression continues to verify existing records survive.

Public connector operations select connector names only, without a local-file setter. reviewed_findings.context: Selected desktop and configured operator atomic writer
reviewed_findings.rationale: All current write/writeString callers use approved desktop chooser destinations or trusted local backup/scouting settings and internally derived checksum/receipt names. No HTTP caller supplies an arbitrary filesystem destination to this helper. The helper stages bytes beside the selected path and replaces the target; contextual acceptance preserves operator path choice without claiming server-export containment or hostile local directory-race protection.

Private final constructor @Value seedCsvPath is consumed by private loadSeedFromCsv during @PostConstruct only. Neither HTTP routes nor desktop/harness actions set or invoke a different seed path. The legacy startup source deliberately permits relative/absolute operator configuration.

The only production signatureCommand caller resolves the fixed absolute Windows system PowerShell tool through TrustedSystemCommands, without PATH search. The script and argument flags are constants; the regular non-link installer path is separate child-environment data read with -LiteralPath, and the publisher subject is never script source. Verification requires zero exit and expected output, with at most 16 KiB output and one bounded completion deadline. Configuration and updater actions are local operator/startup boundaries, not HTTP commands.

reviewed_findings.context: Current installed app executable, without arguments or shell
reviewed_findings.rationale: The admitted launcher must be absolute, a regular non-link executable named FlowersForever or FlowersForever.exe and Files.isSameFile with this running process's command. The startup property cannot select a different program; relaunch supplies exactly this executable and no arguments or shell. Final null-parent guards preserve that boundary. The two callers are desktop backup/update actions with local installed-app configuration, without an HTTP route.

reviewed_findings.context: Admitted system interpreter and one generated installer handoff
reviewed_findings.rationale: InstallerProcessCommand admits only the actual fixed OS interpreter: SystemRoot/System32/cmd.exe with exact /d /c flags or the POSIX system root's bin/sh. It rebuilds argv with exactly one absolute regular non-link generated apply-update/rollback-AppVersion script directly under the existing updates directory, bounded to 64 KiB with bounded arguments and rejected shell metacharacters. UpdateCoordinator/UpdateLaunchGuard verify package hashes and signed release metadata before generating the handoff. The final null guards and structural POSIX-root resolution retain this boundary; no HTTP caller accepts process argv. Trusted local directory and OS configuration replacement by a malicious local owner is outside this contextual decision.

source_review_note: Explicit null DTO rejection in Knowledge/Production controllers; null path guards and fixed POSIX-root tool resolution in InstalledAppLauncher, InstallerProcessCommand and TrustedSystemCommands. FarmTypeLauncher uses the existing measured wrapping toolbar and KnowledgeLogTab reserves a readable workspace height; those UI-only layout changes do not alter input, path, SQL or process boundaries. The complete canonical hosted scan includes these final changes. All annotations, locations and multiplicities remain bound; only unordered Unknown-source String annotation slots are sorted. Final three-source review: SecurityConfig enables the cookie-backed default XOR CSRF handler in both modes; AuthController adds only the public no-store GET masked-token handshake. Neither exposes path, SQL or process configuration. ShopifyConnector restricts remote requests to the admitted HTTPS store product endpoint, disables redirects and bounds linear provider parsing. Its existing operator-configured LocalJsonMirror constructor path and local-mode callers are unchanged. All 545 final production files and the unchanged POM are bound; the 38 previously observed canonical finding annotations/locations and raw hash provenance are unchanged. The next complete hosted scan must independently match these exact contexts; no new finding is approved by this source renewal.
